clue.text: Implausible ability leads to a practice: beginning to embroider footwear

parts.note: extrasensory perception, a supposed mind-reading power many find hard to believe
taken as written

parts.note: the opening letter of embroider

explanation.surface: A doubtful talent leads someone to take up embroidery, starting with their shoes.
explanation.walkthrough: ESP + A + DRILL + E. 'Implausible ability' reads as a description, but it stands for ESP, the paranormal sense.
explanation.definitionFit: An espadrille is a canvas shoe with a rope sole, so it is one kind of footwear.

clue.text: Got angry as English garden deteriorated

indicators.note: something that has deteriorated has fallen into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gardener lost their temper watching their English garden go to ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: Enraged means made furious; as a verb form it matches got angry.

clue.text: Song sung at first in a tree

explanation.walkthrough: P(S)ALM: the opening letter goes inside the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A psalm is a sacred song or hymn, especially one from the biblical Book of Psalms.

clue.text: Democrat and Republican attempted to secure financial backer for satirical film

explanation.walkthrough: D + R + STR(ANGEL)OVE. An angel as a backer is theatre slang for an investor.
explanation.definitionFit: Dr. Strangelove is Stanley Kubrick's 1964 black comedy lampooning nuclear war policy, a satirical film.

clue.text: Popular society girl, supported by Kennedy, is carrying a mortgage

short for debutante, a young woman entering high society

explanation.walkthrough: IN + DEB + TED, stacked from top to bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a mortgage owes money to a lender, which is what being indebted means.

clue.text: Start to exercise when following diet site

explanation.surface: Begin a workout once you have followed a diet website.
explanation.walkthrough: LOCAL + E. 'diet site' reads as a website, but 'site' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A locale is a place or setting where something happens, a synonym of site.

clue.text: Principal curve

clue.text: I narrate badly, taking a sip of whisky (something collected in a barrel)

explanation.walkthrough: The barrel suggests whisky casks, but the thing collected is from the sky: a rain barrel catches it from the roof.
explanation.definitionFit: Rain barrels are set under downspouts to catch runoff from roofs for watering gardens.

clue.text: Risks of Arizona being in challenging straits to begin with

indicators.note: a thing that is in another is enclosed by it

explanation.walkthrough: H(AZ)ARD + S. 'challenging straits' looks like one phrase, but only the first letter of straits is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: Hazards are dangers or sources of risk, so the plural nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Ecstatic harp-disco mash-up

indicators.note: a mash-up blends and remixes material into something new, so these letters get remixed

parts.note: the letters of both words, taken together

explanation.surface: A DJ's blend of harp music and disco has the crowd in raptures.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhapsodic means extravagantly enthusiastic or delighted, a synonym of ecstatic.

clue.text: Dog expectorates in your ear

explanation.walkthrough: SPITS and SPITZ are pronounced the same.
explanation.definitionFit: A spitz is a breed type of dog with a pointed muzzle and curled tail, such as the Pomeranian.

clue.text: Historic force sent to attack London Bridge is hurt by a government lawyer

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish Armada was the 1588 fleet sent by Philip II of Spain to invade England.

clue.text: One who competes with me in Western newspaper

parts.note: rag is slang for a low-quality newspaper
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Western' looks like a description of the paper; in an across clue it tells you to read the paper's word right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamer is a player who takes part in games, especially video games, so a competitor.

clue.text: European conflict to frustrate Sadat

parts.note: to balk is to thwart or hinder
Anwar Sadat was president of Egypt

explanation.surface: A war in Europe is fought to thwart the Egyptian leader Sadat.
explanation.walkthrough: Sadat's first name supplies the second half, so the obvious word for conflict is never clued directly.
explanation.definitionFit: The Balkan Wars of 1912–13 were fought in southeastern Europe, so each was a European conflict.

clue.text: Guard cool Terminator

parts.note: def is hip-hop slang for excellent or cool
something that ends a thing, one that terminates

explanation.definitionFit: A defender protects, and in sport a guard is a defensive position, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Herb's iron rod raised a stink

explanation.walkthrough: FE + NUG + REEK. 'Herb' looks like a man's name, but it is the definition; 'raised a stink' looks like an idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: Fenugreek is an aromatic plant whose leaves and seeds are used as a herb and spice in cooking.

clue.text: Break cover, capturing independent American

parts.note: a hat covers the head
I is the abbreviation for independent
US, the United States

explanation.surface: An independent American candidate breaks cover and is captured.
explanation.walkthrough: H(I)AT + US. 'Break cover' reads as one phrase, but the definition is 'Break' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus is a pause or gap in a series or activity, so it is a break.

clue.text: Painting some chromium on Al is absurd

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the words that follow are used, a run inside them

parts.note: runs from the end of the first word into the first letter of the last

explanation.surface: Painting chromium onto aluminium is a silly idea.
explanation.walkthrough: Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium, which keeps the metal theme going in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mona Lisa is Leonardo da Vinci's portrait in the Louvre, perhaps the world's most famous painting.

clue.text: Customers originally come into downtown

parts.note: the final letter of NBC

explanation.walkthrough: CA SH(C)OW. CA is the postal abbreviation for California, where both series were set.
explanation.definitionFit: A cash cow is a business or product that reliably generates profit, like a cow that is milked.

clue.text: Disturbed and different in bed

indicators.note: something lying in a place is enclosed by it

parts.note: taken as written
other means different

explanation.surface: Someone restless and unlike themselves while lying in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disturbed and different' reads as a pair of adjectives, but only the first is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Bothered means troubled or upset, a close synonym of disturbed.

clue.text: Demolish and deface poems on an ancient city

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem

clue.text: Drive out Saudis (Pelosi's constituents)

clue.text: Head of security largely disregarding a young Italian

parts.note: the opening letter of security

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Signorina is the Italian word for a young or unmarried woman, the counterpart of Miss.

clue.text: Studies Napa's latest in wines

clue.text: Examine the books of evenly valued mint

clue.text: We came around just fine and regained consciousness
